cards.title: Holiday hours notice
cards.text: Write a short holiday hours notice for [BUSINESS]. Dates and hours: [LIST]. Say when we reopen and how to reach us for urgent things: [HOW]. Friendly, under 60 words.

slides.note: Paste your real dates. AI copies what you give it, typos included.

messages.text: Last day Dec 23 (until 3pm). Closed Dec 24 – Jan 1. Back Jan 2. Urgent: text the shop phone.

**Holiday hours at Spoke & Chain**
Our last day this year is Dec 23 (open until 3pm). We're closed Dec 24 – Jan 1 and back to normal hours on Jan 2.
Bike trouble while we're closed? Text the shop phone and we'll reply when we can. Happy holidays!

cards.title: Holiday promo post
cards.text: Write a social post for [BUSINESS] about [YOUR REAL OFFER]. Deadline: [DATE]. No fake urgency, no discounts or prices I didn't give you. 3 short lines + 1 call to action.

slides.note: No real offer? Gift vouchers, booking early or a holiday menu all work.

messages.text: Offer: service gift vouchers, any amount. Order by Dec 20, in store or by DM.

Stuck on a gift for the cyclist in your life?
A Spoke & Chain service voucher, in any amount, keeps their bike rolling into spring.
Order in store or by DM by **Dec 20**.
→ Message us to get yours.

caption:
Holiday season prep for small businesses: hours notice, promo post and auto-reply (AI templates)

Write them now, while it's quiet. Three prompts:

1) "Write a short holiday hours notice for [BUSINESS]. Dates and hours: [LIST]. Say when we reopen and how to reach us for urgent things: [HOW]. Friendly, under 60 words."

2) "Write a social post for [BUSINESS] about [YOUR REAL OFFER]. Deadline: [DATE]. No fake urgency, no discounts or prices I didn't give you. 3 short lines + 1 call to action."

3) "Write an out-of-office reply for [DATES]. Say when we're back, what happens to their message, and what to do if [URGENT CASE]. 3 sentences max. Warm, not cute."

No special offer? Gift vouchers, early booking or simply your hours are enough. Check every date against your calendar before anything goes live.

Follow @nomorebusywork and comment PACK: I'll DM you 21 more prompts.

Save this for later. 📌
